title: Rank-6 matrix to linear map

sourceRefs.summary: Run-contract target that explains why this generated contract exists.
Approved rationale, operation-bank pedagogy, preservation boundary, checkpoint, slice order, verification cadence, stop conditions, and deferrals.
Accepted product sequence places rank-6 host pressure after the completed Svelte catalogue gate and before Internal Studio.

allowedWork: Upgrade the existing generated two-by-two matrix-vector asset in place; add exact operation-bank, dot-product fold, LinearMap, basis, graph, accessibility, browser, visual, performance, promotion, and adjacent-pruning evidence described by the approved proposal.

After the mandatory slice-16 human checkpoint is approved, pressure the same framework-neutral presentation and runtime joints with standalone dot-product and matrix-matrix callers and remove only proven-obsolete compatibility paths.
disallowedWork: Do not move semantic truth, animation assets, clocks, runtime frames, renderer ports, URL or Review authority into Svelte; do not create a fluid simulation, second scheduler, second frame schema, or universal renderer.

Do not implement SvelteKit, Internal Studio, editable matrix parameters, arbitrary-dimensional visualization, determinant or eigen work, Jacobian or Hessian work, rank 7, LLM editorial work, Public Web, or unrelated pruning.
Do not execute s17 through s26 until the user explicitly approves the s16 visual exemplar.
goal: Promote one exact matrix-vector learner artifact that explains row operations through persistent Pour-style information flow, dot-product gather-and-collapse, and a delayed geometric linear-map reveal under one framework-neutral clock, then prove the seam with standalone dot-product and matrix-matrix callers.
commitCadence: Commit after each independently verified slice.
stopConditions: Stop at s16 for explicit human visual approval before local corrections, caller generalization, matrix-matrix work, or compatibility retirement.
Stop if operation-bank presentation would require literal fluid simulation, a second scheduler, a second frame schema, or a universal motif or renderer abstraction.
Stop if exact matrix, vector, result, row-versus-column semantics, basis provenance, accessibility, or framework-neutral authority cannot be preserved.
Stop if work would widen a frozen bundle or runtime ceiling, change canonical public behavior beyond the approved exemplar, or lacks durable and non-contradictory verification.

slices.title: Author operation-bank exemplar contract
slices.summary: Added a framework-neutral, matrix-vector-specific operation-bank contract. It binds exact selector-addressed products [8,5] and [0,15] to outputs [13,15], preserves vector inputs across rows, and explicitly forbids depletion/fluid semantics; no renderer changed.

slices.title: Bind strict LinearMap and basis provenance
slices.summary: Bound A=[[2,1],[0,3]] to one strict LinearMap T_A with explicit standard-basis provenance. Rows remain output-coordinate functionals; columns are mapped basis vectors [2,0] and [1,3], which reconstruct [13,15] from [4,5].

slices.title: Enrich canonical asset with map and graph objects
slices.summary: Enriched the existing canonical matrix-vector asset in place with nine provenance-bearing semantic objects: Matrix, LinearMap, two standard bases, two basis images, Graph2D, v=[4,5], and T_A(v)=[13,15]. Eager test and lazy product catalogues share the enrichment function; no duplicate animation was created.

slices.title: Coordinate equation and graph targets
slices.summary: The canonical asset now exposes equation and graph render targets in one row layout with clockCoupling=shared-progress. Generated descriptors advertise the composite surface, Chromium mounts both slots under one player, and graph paint remains deferred to s15.

slices.title: Compose calculation and application transformations
slices.summary: Added a strict applyLinearMapToVector transformation from (T_A,v) to (T_A,T_A(v)) and composed it in parallel with the existing row calculation under the preserved imported root ID. Equation and graph targets now own their respective transformations without claiming one representation mutates into the other.

slices.title: Add synchronized renderer-neutral rank-6 frame
slices.summary: Added a matrix-linear-map-specific renderer-neutral frame sampled from the existing 2.4-second playhead. It synchronizes persistent input flow, product/gather/coordinate folds, mapped bases, grid transform, vector motion, exact narration, and rewind without a renderer clock or universal schema.

slices.title: Prove exact playback and accessibility laws
slices.summary: Proved deterministic seek and exact rewind for full, reduced, static, and narrated projections. Reduced/static frames expose only 0-or-1 motion values; static playback uses finite row-completion checkpoints; all modes retain A, v, Av, row/column meaning, mapped bases, and live narration.

slices.title: Render persistent operation-bank flow
slices.summary: Rendered the canonical persistent operation-bank exemplar on the equation surface. A and v stay fully visible, two row lanes route exact operand pairs without depletion, resolved coordinates persist, accessibility descriptions are attached, and wide/narrow captures remain contained. Other matrix callers retain their prior overlay pending review and pressure.
